full_native_build: failed at runtime; no valid native kernel output
observation: six synchronous external aborts while clear_page zeroes anonymous THP pages; processes deadlock in exit_mmap after the abort
cause: 7.3 FastRPC assigns the complete reserved ADSP heap to DSP VMIDs at probe, but its reusable CMA property leaves pages available to unrelated Linux allocations after HLOS access is revoked
fix: replace reusable with no-map in SM8750 ADSP reserved heap; retain size/alignment/below-4G placement
remaining: replay/build/DTB checks, new normal boot and native-load validation

additional_evidence.observation: All six 2MiB blocks at fec00000/fee00000/ff000000/ff200000/ff400000/ff600000 report compound-head and THP flags in /proc/kpageflags, confirming normal allocator use of the entire DSP-owned pool. /proc/kcore unavailable; no raw memory read.
